input.question: How long until 3D printers can print out 3D printers?
input.ground_truth: Already, or mostly already. Look up RepRap. _URL_0_ I saw it in action a few years ago, and assume they've made headway. I think it will be a while before we see printed motors and such, but the majority of parts are simple.

Question: How long until 3D printers can print out 3D printers?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Sure! Let’s make it simple:

Imagine you have a magic box (that’s the 3D printer) that can make toys by building them piece by piece. Now, you want this magic box to make another magic box just like itself.

Right now, the magic box can make lots of different things, like toys, cups, or even some parts for another magic box. But it’s not easy for it to make all the tiny, special parts that make another magic box work perfectly.

Some very smart people are trying to make it easier. Maybe in a few years, the magic box will be able to print out another magic box all by itself. But right now, it still needs a little help from people to finish the job.

So, it will take a little while—maybe a few more years—before the magic box can make another magic box all by itself.
